# tlq5l

> Personal tools by Terry, published on GitHub as tlq5l. This file lists the public tools only.

## Tools

- [agentic-video](https://github.com/tlq5l/agentic-video?ref=tlq5l-site-llms-txt): Python library and MCP server that lets an AI agent work with video files on your own machine, using frames, timestamps and transcripts.
- [afk-timer](https://github.com/tlq5l/afk-timer?ref=tlq5l-site-llms-txt): Claude Code mod that shows how long you have been away and whether the prompt cache has likely expired.
- [claude-guards](https://github.com/tlq5l/claude-guards?ref=tlq5l-site-llms-txt): Three hooks for Claude Code that check Bash commands before they run (git data loss, purchases, hidden test failures), plus a streamline skill.
- [shopify-schema-audit](https://github.com/tlq5l/shopify-schema-audit?ref=tlq5l-site-llms-txt): Zero-dependency Node tool that checks a live store's Product structured data, product image alt text and EU GPSR details.

## Optional

- [Privacy policy](https://tlq5l.github.io/privacy.html?ref=tlq5l-site-llms-txt): Privacy policy for Terry's personal tools.
